literal_meaning: চক্র (বৃত্ত বা চাকা) এবং বক্র (বাঁকা বা কুটিল) – কুটিল চক্রাকার আন্দোলন
figurative_meaning_en: Cunning maneuvers; devious strategies; scheming tricks
example_sentences_in_english: He deceived everyone with his cunning maneuvers.
The game of devious strategies is ongoing in politics.
note: This idiom emphasizes indirect and manipulative approaches, common in Bengali literary expressions of intrigue.
